packages.title: KO view: a return into the eyes that matches the body, and room in corners and between fighters
packages.notes:
ORDER: r3look-01 (high) first, then r3look-02 (medium). Both live in first_person_camera.gd and test_ko_view.gd, so they share one owner, but their causes differ. r3look-01 is the return path: _ko_view_mix() blends back toward `live`, which follows the free mouse look, and VIS_FP_HIDDEN is hidden again only at weight 0. r3look-02 is the pose's room: _ko_room() clamps the reach to ko_view_min_reach past the ray's hit, _choose_ko_side() has no fallback when both sides are blocked, and nothing sphere-checks the final lens.

r3look-01:
(1) In _ko_view_mix(), hide VIS_FP_HIDDEN again on the way back as soon as _head_clear_of(lens) turns false (the mirror of the lift).
(2) Make the return's target the eyes the body actually has. In player.gd, touch only _process() (look input), _revive() and _tick_ko(). Either ignore look input while KO'd and through the KO's get-up, or set look_yaw to rotation.y (and settle the pitch) at _revive(). Then the lens comes back to the body's eyes and the body no longer snaps at FREE. This is a simulation-side change and must not read the camera. Record it in the fix json as a control decision for the lead, and choose the variant that changes least for the player. Leave ordinary non-KO knockdowns alone: a view for them is waiting on Game-boy.
(3) Tests with the look turned ±45 and 120 degrees while down. Write look_yaw directly, as the reviewer's KO13/KO14 acts do, since scripted input skips _process(). Each must keep the own body at most a third of the view, nothing within 0.25 m of the lens, and no pop at the re-hide. Also check the plain no-turn return (KO1).

r3look-02:
- Never put the lens past the ray's hit.
- Try fallbacks, scored like the two sides: along the body (past the feet, then past the head), then steeper over the hips.
- Sphere-check the final lens (ko_view_clearance_m) against the world and enemy bodies.
- Tests for a corner (KO7: player at (19.3,0,-6.3), in the end-wall / building-front corner) and for a fighter on each side (KO9). Each must show the whole body in frame, the lens outside all geometry, nothing within 0.25 m, and the own body at most a third.
- New tunables go only in Camera > 'KO view'. Add no new subgroup: test_tuning_panel.gd asserts that Camera's headings are exactly ['KO view'].
- Show the chosen fallback in first-person captures so the lead can show it to Game-boy.

REPRO: the reviewer's /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m2-review-r3look/captures/review_r3look/r3_probe.gd (.tscn), acts KO1, KO7, KO9, KO13 and KO14. Copy it into your own captures/.

APPROVED, KEEP: the out-of-body view and its defaults (1.7 m out, 1.6 m up, 40 degrees down; 0.8 s out, 0.5 s back; side chosen at the killing blow, the right unless the left clearly has more room). It stays presentation-only: it may query physics but never writes game state.

WAITING ON GAME-BOY, DON'T TOUCH: the HUD centre dot and HP bar during the KO view; a KO view for non-KO knockdowns.

SHARED FILES:
- player.gd: only the three functions above. r3-ragdoll-kick-body may touch only the lunge functions.
- tuning_data.gd: only in Camera > 'KO view'.
- tuning/default.json: the lead regenerates it.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: only the 'KO view' section, updated for both fixes. While there, fix r3code-06's two KO-view items if your edits touch those sentences. First, the camera never calls is_ko() on the player: it reads health, rig.global_basis, the Hips point, the interpolated origin, TimeController.scale_for and the other actors for _ko_crowding(). Second, the KO view keeps running behind side view and free fly.

packages.title: Ragdoll: a kick body that doesn't depend on history, no head/arm jump on an at-once take-over, the hook's far fist at the lens, stale comments
packages.notes:
ORDER:
1. r3code-01 (high).
2. r3code-03: same function, Ragdoll.start().
3. r3look-03: the far fist's fling depends on which bodies the kicks land on.
4. r3code-05: comments, once the pick is settled.
If the fixer runs short, drop r3look-03's optional magnetism part first and report it.

SHARED ROOT (r3code-01):
- Ragdoll.start() runs _queue_impulse() before gap-07's seed of the drawn-pose cache, so a new ragdoll's first kick searches the previous ragdoll's stale cache. It lands on the Head on a fresh dummy, but on the Neck after every KO and comeback and after some set_post moves. The hook gives way 0.22-0.41 m depending on that history.
- The hook's lean kick (combat_actor.gd _ragdoll_stagger(), Part.TORSO via rig.ragdoll_hit) searches after the seed, so it moved from UpperChest to Chest. That, not the re-posed far arm, raised the arm-trail ratio to 0.834 and led the lead to relax test_ragdoll.gd's hook check from 0.8 to 0.85.

r3code-01 fix:
- Make the pick independent of the cache with a fixed per-part preference that reproduces the approved push: what a fresh dummy's first search picks, the Head for HEAD and UpperChest for TORSO. Check ARMS, LEGS and ANY against a fresh dummy so they don't change.
- Seed before the search (or search the true pose) for whatever stays nearest-body.
- Give the lean kick UpperChest.
- Restore 0.8 and its comment in test_the_hook_staggers_head_and_arms_ride_the_trunk_and_it_leans_back. Headroom is thin (0.795 without the seed), so report the measured ratio.
- Add a test that the hook's struck bodies and give are the same on a fresh dummy, after set_post moves and after a KO and comeback. The reviewer's probe_kick_body*.gd and probe_hook_seed*.gd in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m2-review-r3code/captures/review_r3code/ show how.

OPEN-QUESTION RISK (r3code-01): do NOT switch to the body nearest the contact on the true pose (Neck/Chest, about 0.22 m). That is the push question waiting on Game-boy. This fix keeps that question's default, the approved README 'stronger staggers' give of about 0.32-0.35 m, on every hook instead of only on some. The lead should reframe the question, because today's code already gives 0.22 m on the first hook after a comeback. If the lead counts the whole pick as waiting on Game-boy, drop r3code-01 and keep the rest; r3code-05's seed comment then just describes the stale-cache pick truthfully.

r3code-03:
- In start(), when at_once and was == PARTIAL, put the already-simulating head and arm bodies on shown[i] (which carries the 0.45 shares) and keep their velocity, as take_over() does. Or ease the shares up to 1.
- Add a no-jump test for an at-once launch out of a stagger: a launch from behind, and P P P P with the dummy's back 0.4 m from the end wall (probe_atonce_partial.gd, probe_wall_pppp.gd).
- Don't change ragdoll_partial_head_influence or ragdoll_partial_arm_influence (open with Game-boy).

r3look-03:
- After r3code-01, first re-measure the far (left) fist through the attacker's lens, on open floor and pinned (the reviewer's r3_probe acts R01, 'W7 ' and W2 in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m2-review-r3look/captures/review_r3look/). It may already have moved.
- Then aim the folded far arm's fling up and away from the attacker in stagger_right_a/b (stagger_left mirrors them). Keep it bent near the guard (approved, gap-04).
- Add a lens test (nothing within 0.25 m, at most half the view, open floor and pinned) in test_stagger_pose.gd or test_ragdoll.gd.
- The pinned case's magnetism change is optional and risky, because it changes reach. Only in player.gd _plan_lunge(), _update_lunge(), _stop_distance() and _lunge_frames(), behind a tunable in 'Magnetism', and only if every combo hit still connects (test_combat_integration.gd, the bots' hit counts). Otherwise leave it and report.
- One skeptic found no written lens rule for an enemy's stagger. If the re-aim can't keep the arm bent near the guard, stop and report. Judge in first person only.

r3code-05: update these comments.
- ragdoll.gd header: three reads (the get-up's hips offset, the respawn's room check, and the walk home's _home_has_room() every tick).
- start()'s doc and the seed comment, after r3code-01.
- The at_once docs in humanoid_rig.gd ragdoll_start() and combat_actor.gd _ragdoll_full(): out of a hold, a blocked launch, a launch from behind.
- time_controller.gd header: the ragdoll also feeds the get-up, the respawn and the walk home.

FILE SPLIT:
- combat_actor.gd is this package's, except r3-dummy-room's parts: the constants block (lines 44-48) and the comment at 137, start_grabbed(), _pin_to_holder(), and the stagger's rig.play blend line in _apply_reaction().
- player.gd: only the four lunge functions. r3-ko-view-return owns _process(), _revive() and _tick_ko().
- tuning_data.gd: only the 'Ragdoll' and 'Magnetism' groups.
- tuning/default.json: the lead regenerates it.
- ARCHITECTURE.md: only the Ragdoll section's 'Partial ... Full' bullet (the at-once take-over out of a running stagger) and its 'Following the sim' bullet (which body the kick lands on).

DOCS FOR THE LEAD'S LEG 3 (r3code-06, not this fixer), after this package:
- the 'Get-up' bullet's 'one of two places' should say three (the walk home too);
- Hit flash 'Frames': impact_frame_ticks() also skips blocked hits and needs vfx_impact_frame_frames > 0;
- the hold view is built by _view_with() with the smoothed shift; view_from_eye() is what the tests use;
- the Interfaces list lacks is_blinking_in(), is_flying() and impact_frame_ticks().
r3-ko-view-return handles the KO-view items.

APPROVED, KEEP: heavy-tier full ragdoll; staggers at 0.9; the contact push with spin caps (more contortion is open); the hook's far arm bent near the guard; the wall crumple and the at-once take-over; the from-behind pitch; KO lie, blink and vanish.

packages.title: Dummy: path check on the walk home, an off-centre comeback, and the last blend constants as tunables
packages.notes:
ORDER: r3code-02 (medium) first, then r3look-04, then r3code-04 (independent and mechanical).

SHARED ROOT (r3code-02, r3look-04): gap-05's comeback and walk-home logic in training_dummy.gd judges a single spot.
- _walk_home() checks only _has_room(_home), never the path, and retries a stuck walk forever.
- _respawn_spot()'s tie-break among equally far ring-1 spots maximises 'ahead', so with the player on the post the dummy blinks in dead centre 0.8 m ahead (56-58% of the first-person view).

r3code-02:
- In _walk_home(), cast the capsule a short way toward the post against LAYER_PLAYER_BODY and LAYER_ENEMY_BODY (built once in _build_room_queries(), like the other queries).
- With a standing body in the way, stand and face the player, as the post rule does.
- After a give-up against the world (a crate or wall), stop retrying until the dummy is hit or moved, or back off.
- New tunables go beside dummy_return_* in 'Reactions'.
- Add tests in test_ko_blink.gd for a player and a crate in the way. The reviewer's probe_walk_into.gd is in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m2-review-r3code/captures/review_r3code/.
- Simulation never reads a camera: use player.get_forward() and positions, as now. Leave the sparring branch alone.

r3look-04:
- Change the tie-break among equally far spots so the dummy stands off-centre but in view (for example the spot nearest 45-60 degrees off the player's facing), or prefer a minimum flat distance.
- Prefer this over raising dummy_respawn_gap_m: its doc ties it to never touching the body on the post, and ring 2 would move out too.
- Extend test_ko_blink's comeback test with a first-person share check: at most half the view (the reviewer's K4 act in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m2-review-r3look/captures/review_r3look/r3_probe.gd).

APPROVED, KEEP:
- a dummy comes back in front of or beside the player, with room, and waits instead of walking into him;
- rings spaced by dummy_respawn_gap_m, ties broken toward the player's view, ring 2 only when ring 1 has no spot in view;
- return_home's current numbers.
If a new path check reads the drawn ragdoll (as _has_room() does), tell the lead: ragdoll.gd's header (owned by r3-ragdoll-kick-body) and ARCHITECTURE's 'Get-up' sentence count those reads.

r3code-04:
- In combat_actor.gd, touch only the constants block (lines 44-48 and the _GRAB_EASE_S comment at 137), start_grabbed() (both _HELD_BLEND_S uses), _pin_to_holder(), and the stagger's rig.play(..., 0.04) line in _apply_reaction(). r3-ragdoll-kick-body owns the rest of the file.
- Keep today's values. Put grab_hold_blend_s (0.12) and grab_pin_ease_s (0.23) in 'Grab and weapons' ABOVE the @export_subgroup('Hold view') line, so they don't fall into that subgroup.
- Add a separate stagger snap blend (0.04) in 'Reactions' beside reaction_snap_blend_s. Folding it into reaction_snap_blend_s would change the stagger to 0.03 s. Update reaction_snap_blend_s's doc.
- Extend test_launch_from_hold.gd's test_the_release_and_snap_blends_are_tunables_with_the_values_they_had.
- Add no new subgroups: test_tuning_panel.gd asserts the headings.

SHARED FILES:
- tuning_data.gd: only 'Grab and weapons' (above 'Hold view') and 'Reactions'.
- tuning/default.json: the lead regenerates it.
- ARCHITECTURE.md: only the Ragdoll section's 'KO and blink-off' bullet and its 'Someone on the post' sub-bullet (the comeback tie-break and the walk home).
